title: Distance preserved by sign encoding
statement: Let $f,g:\\mathbb F_2^n\\to\\mathbb F_2$ be Boolean functions. Encode each output bit $b$ by the sign $(-1)^b$, viewed as a real number. The relative Hamming distance between the resulting real-valued functions equals the relative Hamming distance between $f$ and $g$.
hypotheses_covered: $f,g$ are functions from $\\mathbb F_2^n$ to $\\mathbb F_2$
